paraphrase.proposes: The track adds two sections to the www Tutor Advantage page in en, th, and zh. Phase 1 builds a pure satang-exact commission module, a client calculator with three example presets, a one-level leg payout graph, and a decorative rate curve. Phase 2 adds a gallery of three blurred screenshots from the delivered set and replaces the two 'We do not publish income figures' live lines with copy that points at the calculator examples. The zh block takes the English lines until the contracted Chinese speaker delivers. No push happens before the PM page-check, and no deploy command runs.
paraphrase.current_system: The page is a server component that reads copy with getScopedI18n from a locale file with en, th, and zh blocks. Its sections are hero, process, tutorRole, commitments, and faq; tutorRole.points[3] and faq.items[5].answer still say no income figures are published. A productPictures manifest and the ProductPicture and SectionHeader components already exist for other pages. The commission truth lives in the finance-mlm-service formula; this track re-implements it as a display-only pure module in the www app, with the rate curve and the 3% withholding tax.
